title.narrative: Henan Xichuan Integrated Ecological Protection and Environment Improvement

description.narrative: The proposed project will promote environmental improvements and green development in ecologically sensitive rural areas by (i) building the capacity of the Xichuan County Government (XCG) in environmental planning and management; (ii) promoting soil and water conservation through the use of high-level technology, including remote sensing, smart drip irrigation, and landscape-based rainfall runoff harvesting; and (iii) improving rural waste management and integrated urban?rural water supply systems. The project will (i) play a demonstrative role for rural vitalization; (ii) promote regional public goods by preserving natural resources and reversing the negative impacts of environmental pollution; and (iii) facilitate recovery in the project area from the economic impacts of the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) through inclusive rural economic development.

Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 4070: 55% of contracts awarded and 27% disbursed as of 17 Apr 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: The project was approved on 31 May 2021 and became effective on 20 December 2021. The project is in smooth implementation and the impact on outcome will be evaluated at mid-term and project completion.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jun 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/53053/53053-001-apfs-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Dec 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/53053/53053-001-rp-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | Jun 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/53053/53053-001-sddr-en_3.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Jan 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/53053/53053-001-smr-en_6.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: The project is going smoothly.
Four start-up individual consultants were recruited in May 2021 via advance procurement. Two external monitoring consulting firm on resettlement & social and environment respectively were recruited in March 2022.
The project management and capacity building consulting firm was recruited in June 2022.
By 25 September 2023, 13 civil works contracts and 1 goods contract were awarded and approved by ADB with total contract value of $40.2 million.
Safeguards aspects are under monitoring and monitoring reports have been submitted on time.
